versions.changelog:
- No changes detected in this version.
- All features and documentation remain the same.

Initial release of cn-todo-today.

- Manage today's todo items simply from the command line.
- Add, mark as done, list, and delete todo tasks.
- View completion statistics for the day.
- Todos stored locally in a JSON file under the user’s home directory.
- Old completed tasks are auto-cleaned daily.
- Only requires Python 3 with no extra dependencies.
